statement: The complete preregistered request-enrichment matrix across dataset size, fanout, locality, and skew produces correctness-equivalent paired SLO capacity, whole-topology resource, infrastructure-cost, uncertainty, and practical-effect evidence for every cell regardless of direction.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Do not seal this Quest until benchmark-statistical-capacity-protocol and benchmark-whole-topology-resource-accounting are terminal.
Closure requires valid evidence or explicit non-measuring classification for every preregistered cell and never requires Lagrange to win.
The workload measures existing attribution, routing, placement, decay, and hysteresis owners and must not introduce alternative affinity semantics.
Apply the harness-fidelity attack checklist and retain immutable raw artifacts plus live engagement evidence for each measured matrix identity.
